scenes.line1: How do you debug .NET apps in production?
scenes.say: Ever wonder how to quickly spot and fix .NET issues in production? Which tool do you grab first?

scenes.label: Counters
scenes.sub: dotnet-counters shows live CPU, memory, and thread stats.
scenes.say: Start with dotnet-counters. It streams live stats like CPU, memory, and thread usage, so you can spot trouble as it happens.

scenes.title: dotnet-trace Example
scenes.say: Need more detail? Use dotnet-trace to record what the app is doing over time. It helps you find slow code and bottlenecks.
If the app crashes or leaks memory, dotnet-dump grabs a snapshot of its memory. You can analyze it offline, no restart needed.

scenes.question: Which tool gives live metrics?
scenes.right: dotnet-counters streams live metrics. dotnet-dump is for memory snapshots.
scenes.say: Don't mix them up! Only dotnet-counters shows live metrics. Dotnet-dump is for memory snapshots and offline analysis.
